    LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.contour_cross

    Crossing factorizations in a contour #

    For a contour (v₁ v₂, w₁ w₂) with v₁ and w₂ nonempty, the tail v₂ does not factor as g ≫ w₂ and the head w₁ does not factor as v₁ ≫ g (RayCat.contour_cross): either factorization would interlace the two paths.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.contour_cross {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] (hL : LeftCancel P) (hR : RightCancel P) {x a b y : RayVert P} (v₁ : Quiver.Path x a) (v₂ : Quiver.Path a y) (w₁ : Quiver.Path x b) (w₂ : Quiver.Path b y) (hval : pathVal (v₁.comp v₂) = pathVal (w₁.comp w₂)) (h0 : pathVal (v₁.comp v₂) ≠ 0) (hni : ¬Interlaced (v₁.comp v₂) (w₁.comp w₂)) (hv₁ : 0 < v₁.length) (hw₂ : 0 < w₂.length) :
    (¬∃ (g : a.out ⟶ b.out), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g (pathVal w₂) = pathVal v₂) ∧ ¬∃ (g : a.out ⟶ b.out), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (pathVal v₁) g = pathVal w₁

    Crossing factorizations interlace a contour.
